1.zh: 保罗、西拉、提摩太写信给帖撒罗尼迦在父　神和主耶稣基督里的教会。愿恩惠、平安归与你们！
1.en: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1.zh: 我们为你们众人常常感谢　神，祷告的时候提到你们，
1.en: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

1.zh: 在　神—我们的父面前，不住地记念你们因信心所做的工夫，因爱心所受的劳苦，因盼望我们主耶稣基督所存的忍耐。
1.en: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

1.zh: 被　神所爱的弟兄啊，我知道你们是蒙拣选的；
1.en: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,

1.zh: 因为我们的福音传到你们那里，不独在乎言语，也在乎权能和圣灵，并充足的信心。正如你们知道，我们在你们那里，为你们的缘故是怎样为人。
1.en: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

1.zh: 并且你们在大难之中，蒙了圣灵所赐的喜乐，领受真道就效法我们，也效法了主；
1.en: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

1.zh: 甚至你们作了马其顿和亚该亚所有信[主]之人的榜样。
1.en: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

1.zh: 因为主的道从你们那里已经传扬出来。你们向　神的信心不但在马其顿和亚该亚，就是在各处也都传开了，所以不用我们说什么话。
1.en: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not say anything.

1.zh: 因为他们自己已经报明我们是怎样进到你们那里，你们是怎样离弃偶像，归向　神，要服事那又真又活的　神，
1.en: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,

1.zh: 等候他儿子从天降临，就是他从死里复活的—那位救我们脱离将来忿怒的耶稣。
1.en: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

2.zh: 弟兄们，你们自己原晓得我们进到你们那里并不是徒然的。
2.en: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,

2.zh: 我们从前在腓立比被害受辱，这是你们知道的；然而还是靠我们的　神放开胆量，在大争战中把　神的福音传给你们。
2.en: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.

2.zh: 我们的劝勉不是出于错误，不是出于污秽，也不是用诡诈。
2.en: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.

2.zh: 但　神既然验中了我们，把福音托付我们，我们就照样讲，不是要讨人喜欢，乃是要讨那察验我们心的　神喜欢。
2.en: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak—not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.

2.zh: 因为我们从来没有用过谄媚的话，这是你们知道的；也没有藏着贪心，这是　神可以作见证的。
2.en: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),

2.zh: 我们作基督的使徒，虽然可以叫人尊重，却没有向你们或向别人求荣耀；
2.en: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

2.zh: 只在你们中间存心温柔，如同母亲乳养自己的孩子。
2.en: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

2.zh: 我们既是这样爱你们，不但愿意将　神的福音给你们，连自己的性命也愿意给你们，因你们是我们所疼爱的。
2.en: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.

2.zh: 弟兄们，你们记念我们的辛苦劳碌，昼夜做工，传　神的福音给你们，免得叫你们一人受累。
2.en: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.

2.zh: 我们向你们信[主]的人，是何等圣洁、公义、无可指摘，有你们作见证，也有　神作见证。
2.en: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.

2.zh: 你们也晓得，我们怎样劝勉你们，安慰你们，嘱咐你们各人，好像父亲待自己的儿女一样，
2.en: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,

2.zh: 要叫你们行事对得起那召你们进他国、得他荣耀的　神。
2.en: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

2.zh: 为此，我们也不住地感谢　神，因你们听见我们所传　神的道就领受了；不以为是人的道，乃以为是　神的道。这道实在是　神的，并且运行在你们信[主]的人心中。
2.en: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.

2.zh: 弟兄们，你们曾效法犹太中在基督耶稣里　神的各教会；因为你们也受了本地人的苦害，像他们受了犹太人的苦害一样。
2.en: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews

2.zh: 这犹太人杀了主耶稣和先知，又把我们赶出去。他们不得　神的喜悦，且与众人为敌，
2.en: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,

2.zh: 不许我们传道给外邦人使外邦人得救，常常充满自己的罪恶。　[神的]忿怒临在他们身上已经到了极处。
2.en: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.

2.zh: 弟兄们，我们暂时与你们离别，是面目离别，心里却不离别；我们极力地想法子，很愿意见你们的面。
2.en: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,

2.zh: 所以我们有意到你们那里；我—保罗有一两次要去，只是撒但阻挡了我们。
2.en: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.

2.zh: 我们的盼望和喜乐，并所夸的冠冕是什么呢？岂不是我们主耶稣来的时候、你们在他面前站[立得住]吗？
2.en: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

2.zh: 因为你们就是我们的荣耀，我们的喜乐。
2.en: For you are our glory and our joy.

3.zh: 我们既不能再忍，就愿意独自等在雅典，
3.en: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,

3.zh: 打发我们的兄弟在基督福音上作　神执事的提摩太前去，坚固你们，并在你们所信的道上劝慰你们，
3.en: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,

3.zh: 免得有人被诸般患难摇动。因为你们自己知道，我们受患难原是命定的。
3.en: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.

3.zh: 我们在你们那里的时候，预先告诉你们，我们必受患难，以后果然应验了，你们也知道。
3.en: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.

3.zh: 为此，我既不能再忍，就打发人去，要晓得你们的信心如何，恐怕那诱惑人的到底诱惑了你们，叫我们的劳苦归于徒然。
3.en: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

3.zh: 但提摩太刚才从你们那里回来，将你们信心和爱心的好消息报给我们，又说你们常常记念我们，切切地想见我们，如同我们想见你们一样。
3.en: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.

3.zh: 所以，弟兄们，我们在一切困苦患难之中，因着你们的信心就得了安慰。
3.en: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.

3.zh: 你们若靠主站立得稳，我们就活了。
3.en: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.

3.zh: 我们在　神面前，因着你们甚是喜乐；为这一切喜乐，可用何等的感谢为你们报答　神呢？
3.en: For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,

3.zh: 我们昼夜切切地祈求，要见你们的面，补满你们信心的不足。
3.en: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

3.zh: 愿　神—我们的父和我们的主耶稣一直引领我们到你们那里去。
3.en: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.

3.zh: 又愿主叫你们彼此相爱的心，并爱众人的心都能增长，充足，如同我们爱你们一样，
3.en: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

3.zh: 好使你们当我们主耶稣同他众圣徒来的时候，在我们父　神面前，心里坚固，成为圣洁，无可责备。
3.en: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

4.zh: 弟兄们，我还有话说：我们靠着主耶稣求你们，劝你们，你们既然受了我们的教训，知道该怎样行可以讨　神的喜悦，就要照你们现在所行的更加勉励。
4.en: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.

4.zh: 你们原晓得，我们凭主耶稣传给你们什么命令。
4.en: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

4.zh: 神的旨意就是要你们成为圣洁，远避淫行；
4.en: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

4.zh: 要你们各人晓得怎样用圣洁、尊贵守着自己的身体，
4.en: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor,

4.zh: 不放纵私欲的邪情，像那不认识　神的外邦人。
4.en: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,

4.zh: 不要一个人在这事上越分，欺负他的弟兄；因为这一类的事，主必报应，正如我预先对你们说过、又切切嘱咐你们的。
4.en: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.

4.zh: 神召我们，本不是要我们沾染污秽，乃是要我们成为圣洁。
4.en: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

4.zh: 所以，那弃绝的，不是弃绝人，乃是弃绝那赐圣灵给你们的　神。
4.en: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

4.zh: 论到弟兄们相爱，不用人写信给你们；因为你们自己蒙了　神的教训，叫你们彼此相爱。
4.en: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,

4.zh: 你们向马其顿全地的众弟兄固然是这样行，但我劝弟兄们要更加勉励。
4.en: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;

4.zh: 又要立志作安静人，办自己的事，亲手做工，正如我们从前所吩咐你们的，
4.en: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,

4.zh: 叫你们可以向外人行事端正，自己也就没有什么缺乏了。
4.en: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.

4.zh: 论到睡了的人，我们不愿意弟兄们不知道，恐怕你们忧伤，像那些没有指望的人一样。
4.en: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope.

4.zh: 我们若信耶稣死而复活了，那已经在耶稣里睡了的人，　神也必将他们与耶稣一同带来。
4.en: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.

4.zh: 我们现在照主的话告诉你们一件事：我们这活着还存留到主降临的人，断不能在那已经睡了的人之先。
4.en: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.

4.zh: 因为主必亲自从天降临，有呼叫的声音和天使长的声音，又有　神的号[吹响]；那在基督里死了的人必先复活。
4.en: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,

4.zh: 以后我们这活着还存留的人必和他们一同被提到云里，在空中与主相遇。这样，我们就要和主永远同在。
4.en: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.

4.zh: 所以，你们当用这些话彼此劝慰。
4.en: Therefore comfort one another with these words.

5.zh: 弟兄们，论到时候、日期，不用写信给你们，
5.en: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.

5.zh: 因为你们自己明明晓得，主的日子来到，好像夜间的贼一样。
5.en: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

5.zh: 人正说「平安稳妥」的时候，灾祸忽然临到他们，如同产难临到怀胎的妇人一样，他们绝不能逃脱。
5.en: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.

5.zh: 弟兄们，你们却不在黑暗里，叫那日子临到你们像贼一样。
5.en: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.

5.zh: 你们都是光明之子，都是白昼之子。我们不是属黑夜的，也不是属幽暗的。
5.en: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,

5.zh: 所以，我们不要睡觉像别人一样，总要警醒谨守。
5.en: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.

5.zh: 因为睡了的人是在夜间睡，醉了的人是在夜间醉。
5.en: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

5.zh: 但我们既然属乎白昼，就应当谨守，把信和爱当作护心镜遮胸，把得救的盼望当作头盔戴上。
5.en: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

5.zh: 因为　神不是预定我们受刑，乃是预定我们借着我们主耶稣基督得救。
5.en: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

5.zh: 他替我们死，叫我们无论醒着，睡着，都与他同活。
5.en: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

5.zh: 所以，你们该彼此劝慰，互相建立，正如你们素常所行的。
5.en: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

5.zh: 弟兄们，我们劝你们敬重那在你们中间劳苦的人，就是在主里面治理你们、劝戒你们的；
5.en: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

5.zh: 又因他们所做的工，用爱心格外尊重他们。你们也要彼此和睦。
5.en: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

5.zh: 我们又劝弟兄们，要警戒不守规矩的人，勉励灰心的人，扶助软弱的人，也要向众人忍耐。
5.en: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

5.zh: 你们要谨慎，无论是谁都不可以恶报恶；或是彼此相待，或是待众人，常要追求良善。
5.en: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.

5.zh: 要常常喜乐，
5.en: Always rejoice.

5.zh: 不住地祷告，
5.en: Pray without ceasing.

5.zh: 凡事谢恩；因为这是　神在基督耶稣里向你们所定的旨意。
5.en: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

5.zh: 不要消灭[圣]灵[的感动]；
5.en: Don’t quench the Spirit.

5.zh: 不要藐视先知的讲论。
5.en: Don’t despise prophecies.

5.zh: 但要凡事察验；善美的要持守，
5.en: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

5.zh: 各样的恶事要禁戒不做。
5.en: Abstain from every form of evil.

5.zh: 愿赐平安的　神亲自使你们全然成圣！又愿你们的灵与魂与身子得蒙保守，在我们主耶稣基督降临的时候，完全无可指摘！
5.en: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

5.zh: 那召你们的本是信实的，他必成就这事。
5.en: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

5.zh: 请弟兄们为我们祷告。
5.en: Brothers, pray for us.

5.zh: 与众弟兄亲嘴问安，务要圣洁。
5.en: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

5.zh: 我指着主嘱咐你们，要把这信念给众弟兄听。
5.en: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

5.zh: 愿我主耶稣基督的恩[常]与你们同在！
5.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
